items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: I've seen them since I looked at Lawrence Wells.

ctx.x: Yeah, she played piano at 16. She danced on the stage. She was just... She was a swinger. She could dance any kind of dance. She still likes it too. She had to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing to sing…
Did they have any, what other places did they have here besides West End that they played jazz? How about out on the camps, out on the lake? Did they have bands out there?
